summary: Iter14 tested the multi-branch features (backend and UI): stock at every branch, nearest-store suggestion, moving the cart between branches, 'Ambil di toko' pickup checkout and the seller store address/pickup hours fields. Backend: 16/17 new tests pass. The one failure is minor: the availability/suggest store rows leave out address/pickup_hours when the DB has no value for them. Regression suites iter3/5/7/9/10 pass after fixing 2 outdated test assertions. UI checks passed on all 7 requested flows: product page branch stock with Terdekat badge and 'Belanja di sini', /pilih-toko distance and badge, checkout nearest banner with Pindah, pickup box with 'Ambil di sini', a pickup order placed in the UI going to Jember (Rp0, listed for the jember seller, stock restored after cancel), seller store edit, and a normal checkout with auto rates and a voucher. One logic bug found: checkout fills the city field with 'Sidoarjo' by default and uses it as the buyer's area, so buyers with no saved address get a wrong 'PGS Sidoarjo lebih dekat ±0 km' suggestion. No deprecated Expo packages detected.

minor.issue: Store rows leave out the address/pickup_hours keys when the store document has no such field (projection only returns fields that exist). Today Jombang/Jember are missing both keys, which breaks the documented response shape. Fix: default them with s.get('address') or '' in branches.py suggest() (~line 84).

branches.py:115 builds the target with i.get('store_id') == to_store_id but no default, while kept/moving use i.get('store_id', PGS_STORE_ID). When moving to pgs-official, a legacy cart item with no store_id field would be removed from both lists and lost. Low risk because add_to_cart always sets store_id now. Also, the target store's status=active is never checked.

Mitra PGS Jombang/Jember were seeded with phone ''. StoreIn requires a phone of at least 8 characters, so these store admins cannot save the new address/hours until they also enter a phone. The UI shows the 'Lengkapi ... nomor HP' error, but the seed should have a phone or the error should be clearer.

ui_bugs.issue: checkout.tsx:27 sets the city to 'Sidoarjo' by default and line 193 passes area={dest?.label || city}. A buyer with no saved address, at a Jember/Jombang cart, sees co-nearest-banner 'PGS Sidoarjo lebih dekat ±0 km ... (toko sekarang ±135 km)', and in pickup mode Sidoarjo is marked 'Terdekat'. Reproduced with a fresh TEST user and a Jember cart. Fix: only pass an area the buyer actually entered or saved (dest label or a typed city), not the placeholder default.

issues: The pd-branch-switch-* 'Belanja di sini' buttons are 36px high (minHeight 36), below the 44px touch target.
The list is not sorted nearest-first: Jember shows last with the Terdekat badge for a Jember buyer.
The text '±0 km dari alamat Anda' reads oddly when the buyer is in the same city; show something like '< 1 km' or 'Di kota Anda' (also in branch-availability and branch-switcher).
With 'Ambil di toko' selected, the address fields (co-address, at least 5 characters) are still required and the destination search stays visible.
The co-pickup-box appears above the courier list, so it can be off-screen when the buyer taps 'Ambil di toko' further down.
It still shows 'No. resi: belum ada' and 'Dikirim ke <buyer address>'. It should show the pickup store's address and pickup hours instead.
The courier choice is kept by code (e.g. JNE CTC 9.000) and not re-picked as the cheapest at the new branch (SiCepat 6.900). This is minor, since it may be intended.

action_items: Checkout: stop using the default city 'Sidoarjo' as the nearest-branch area when the buyer has no saved or entered address (checkout.tsx:27/193).
branches.py suggest(): always return address and pickup_hours, defaulting to ''.
branches.py move_cart: use i.get('store_id', PGS_STORE_ID) when building the target; optionally check that the target store is active.

Optional UX: sort /pilih-toko nearest-first, show '< 1 km' instead of '±0 km', raise the pd-branch-switch buttons to 44px, show pickup store details on pickup order detail, don't require a shipping address for pickup, and debounce suggestStores while typing in the city field (it currently fires on every keystroke).
critical_code_review_comments: BranchSwitcher useEffect depends on area = dest?.label || city, so every keystroke in co-city triggers POST /stores/suggest with no debounce.
suggest() makes one stock query per store (N+1). Fine for 3 branches.
Distances are straight-line from static city centroids (Gubeng to Sidoarjo shows ±21 km because Surabaya's centroid is used). This is acceptable as approximate.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_pgs_iter3_promo.py (line 163: uses o['shipping_cost'] since the default courier is pickup)

success_rate.backend: 94% (16/17 iter14; regression iter3/5/7/9/10 all pass after test fixes)
success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows work; 1 logic bug (placeholder-city nearest suggestion) plus minor UX items

seed_data_creation: Created TEST buyers test_ui14_* and test_pick_* with saved addresses (Gubeng 69243, Patrang 30945), plus a TEST_Exclusive Jember product that was deleted via the seller API. All test orders were cancelled: PGS-261108-DE10D7, A564F9, plus EBAAEC and DADA06 left by the old promo test, which never cancels its order. Stock for pgs-9955 is back to 214/218/218. pgs-official address/pickup_hours were set to '' (were missing before); Jombang/Jember untouched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/backend && export $(grep EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL /app/frontend/.env | xargs) && pytest tests/test_pgs_iter14_pickup_nearest.py -n 0. Its availability test is expected to fail until address/pickup_hours are always returned. tests/ui_iter14_helper.py creates buyers with saved areas (prints tokens). For UI, inject the token into localStorage 'pgs_auth_token'. Scroll elements to the centre before clicking on the product page: the sticky bottom bar (Keranjang/Beli) covers the lower buttons, and a force click there adds the item to the cart. test_pgs_iter3_promo leaves a COD order with a TESTV* voucher; cancel it via admin.
rca_of_issue: Wrong nearest suggestion: checkout keeps city state = 'Sidoarjo' as a form default and BranchSwitcher treats it as the buyer's real area. locate('Sidoarjo') works, so suggested = pgs-official at 0 km. Fix by tracking whether the city came from the user.
